name: Iridescence-TS-TW
title: Iridescence
blurb: Shifting color waves with recursive trigonometric patterns.
description: WebGL shader creating iridescent wave patterns through recursive trigonometric functions. Supports customizable color, speed, and optional mouse-reactive amplitude distortion.
use_when: Subtle, elegant backgrounds where shifting color waves add visual interest without overwhelming content.
avoid_when: When static backgrounds are needed, or high contrast is required for readability.
a11y: WebGL canvas with optional mouse reactivity. No semantic content or keyboard navigation. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
